answer: Burn, don't just bond: every new identity must destroy POA before it can answer, priced by an opal ledger that counts how many identities the same funding wallet already spawned — first 10 POA, tenth 100, hundredth 1,000, so the delta between one user and a thousand fakes is the curve itself. Each receipt is an onyx-black, epoch-seeded commitment no farmer can recycle across clones. A thousand fakes would burn about 500,000 POA outright, far above any epoch payout. Limits: each epoch's first identity is subsidized from the jury pool, and burn proofs are re-checked at every epoch close.
